claim: Try it with sample data opens a three-stop reading rail right away.
where: Home page action and demo banner
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo and asserts seeded sample content, three stops, and demo controls.

claim: Demo sample data is not saved with your reading data.
sandbox: Fresh context writes demo data, starts for real, and asserts the real IndexedDB namespace is empty while the demo namespace is discarded.

claim: Reading data stays in this browser; no account, cloud upload, tracking, or third-party runtime request is needed to read and save a note.
where: Home facts, import guidance, README, Privacy
sandbox: Fresh demo flow observes browser-context traffic, confirms at least one runtime request, only same-origin GET/HEAD traffic, saves a note, and asserts there are no email or password fields.

claim: Continues offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh demo visit waits for the active service worker, sets the context offline, reloads, and reads the seeded rail.

claim: Exports and restores documents, reading positions, notes, and preferences as JSON.
sandbox: Fresh demo changes position and settings, downloads JSON, removes a note and changes settings, then restores and asserts the original document, position, note, and settings.

claim: Opens readable text from a standard EPUB in this browser.
sandbox: Fresh browser imports a generated standard EPUB and asserts its text opens as a reading route.

claim: Left and right arrows move one stop; N focuses the note field.
sandbox: Fresh browser creates a three-stop route, uses ArrowRight, then presses N and asserts note-field focus.

claim: Lets you save reading type, size, spacing, theme, contrast, motion, sprint, break, and word-cue preferences.
sandbox: Fresh browser changes the listed settings and asserts the applied reader state after saving.

claim: Saves and deletes one-line notes at the current stop.
sandbox: Fresh browser saves a note at stop one, then deletes it after explicit confirmation.
